blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Puerto Galera is crafting a comprehensive mental health program to expand community-based support, establish barangay referral systems, and raise awareness in schools and workplaces. Proposed Municipal Ordinance No. 009-2026, authored by Councilor Aristotle Von Atienza, seeks to institutionalize mental health awareness, promotion, and support programs throughout the town. It establishes a Municipal Mental Health Program (MMHP) under the supervision of the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office to coordinate local mental health initiatives, implement policies and develop referral networks.
